title: Absence of sugar readings in the History section if one-minute values are received from the sensor.
body:
I came across the fact that in the History section there is a limit on the number of sugar values. For example, if I receive 1 minute readings from Juggluco (Libre2), then for part of the night from 00:00 to 03:00-06:00 am (depending on how many readings there were during the day) there will be no readings. That is, the readings per day will be less than 1*60*24.
If I select 5-minute sugar values for display, then the sugar readings for the day will be complete.
Is it possible to increase the number of sugar storage points in the History section?
